bullets.text: X Copies Bluesky's Starterpacks - **X** introduces its own version of **Bluesky**'s popular user suggestion feature.
Anker's Power Bank Excellence - The **Anker MagGo** power bank stands out with its built-in **Apple Watch** charger and LED display.
Pixel 10's Magic Cue Expansion - **Google** is enhancing the Pixel 10's Magic Cue with integration for **Tasks** and **Wallet**.
iPhone 18 Pro's Display Innovations - The upcoming **iPhone 18 Pro** may feature under-display **Face ID** and improved battery efficiency.
Samsung's Home Up Upgrade - **Samsung**'s **Home Up** module for **One UI 8.5** adds new customization tools for homescreens.
iOS 26 Photos App Enhancements - The **Photos** app in **iOS 26** now recognizes events and groups related photos accordingly.
AI Artists Rally Against Theft - 800 creatives unite against AI companies accused of stealing their work in the campaign 'Stealing Isn’t Innovation.'
Apple's AI Wearable Rumors - **Apple** is reportedly developing an AI-powered wearable pin with cameras and microphones.
Blue Origin's TeraWave Launch - **Blue Origin** announces **TeraWave**, promising satellite internet speeds of up to 6 Tbps.
Zipline Expands Drone Delivery - **Zipline** secures $600M to expand its drone delivery services across the U.S.
